analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for the past two consecutive sessions. RSI has retreated from overbought territory but remains at 65.1, near the upper end of the neutral zone. MACD histogram shows improvement but has not yet turned positive. Volume ratio of 0.60 compared to the 5-day average indicates subdued trading, suggesting a lack of momentum for trend reversal. Confirmation at the $0.25 support level is required.
